title: The Contact card shows labelled phones, copy and tap
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in as a service advisor with edit-customer permission (which governs sending), on the build under test.
  2. Open Customers > Maintenance reminders and use a row's Contact button to open the contact card. Seed a worklist row: enrol an asset (asset Maintenance tab -> Enroll in Schedule) whose customer has contact details.
  3. The row's customer has a telephone, mobile, company telephone and an email on file (set on the customer record).
custom_steps:
1. Open the contact card from the row's Contact button and read the numbers, their labels and order.
  2. Find the copy control on the email address.
  3. Tap/click a phone number (open the card on a phone to confirm it is tappable).
  4. Hover the copy control beside the email address.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The card carries the contact's telephone and mobile, then the customer's company telephone, each labelled.
  • The email address has a copy control.
  • A phone number is tappable, so the card is usable on a phone.
  • On the design its tooltip reads "Copy address".
